description: Use this ONLY when a user explicitly asks to be contacted about one-to-one coaching, or explicitly asks to apply for coaching. Collects name, email, goal, and an optional note, then creates a lead for the coach. Do NOT use proactively, do NOT use to upsell, and do NOT use it as a lead-capture step at the end of a free interaction — only on an explicit request from the user. There is no in-plugin purchase: coaching is sold and scheduled separately, so this tool only records interest.

consentGranted.description: Must be true. Confirms the user agreed to be contacted about coaching.

email.description: The user's email address, for the coach to reply to.

goal.description: The primary outcome they want coaching for.

note.description: Optional message. Do not include medical history, medications, diagnoses, government identifiers, or payment details — those are rejected and not stored.

name: fitness.submit_coaching_interest
title: Submit Coaching Interest
